claims.summary: The release is grounded in a fresh deployed v0.15.92 UX ZIP/log audit that regraded 96/A with citation review-row caveats and deterministic texture repetition.
Source-finder topics now drop unused false-friend candidates from exported review notes once trusted concept-linked source rows cover the topic.
DOI-backed CC-licensed syllabus readings about HCI or human-AI interaction normalize as trusted concept-linked source rows instead of review notes.
Lesson-plan and slide-deck compiler templates now vary the exact repeated tails found in the v0.15.92 texture evidence.
The release explicitly carries forward fresh deployed v0.15.93 ZIP/log validation before claiming clean 100/100 provider output.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh v0.15.93 UX ZIP/log audit and verify no known false-friend review rows ship as package caveats, HCI DOI readings are trusted when licensed, and texture improves from the v0.15.92 baseline.
